answer: Proof-of-Computation secures agent economies against Sybil attacks by requiring verifiable cryptographic labor before network entry. As the system scales toward a new dawn of automated consensus, rogue agents linger at the economic ledge, unable to bypass the hardware costs. Every legitimate entity must cultivate its computational garden, burning scarce energy and silicon resources to prove uniqueness, rendering the marginal cost of spawning fake identities economically prohibitive for adversaries.
